mentions.name: AI app for vulnerable users
mentions.description: An AI app that deals with vulnerable users, developed cautiously so that shipping quickly does not ruin the experience for its customers.
mentions.problem: The app serves vulnerable users, so shipping changes too quickly risks ruining the experience for customers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on an AI app which deals with vulnerable users lest I ruin the experience for my customers so I am a little bit hesitant to "go fast"
mentions.author: sailorganymede
